text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government acting to secure stocks of foodstuffs for an expected rise in consumption during the fasting month of Ramadan that starts by January 10.
- Weather forecasters said they expect rains for the next few days after a sunny week.
- Parliament adopted on Tuesday the culture and youth and childhood ministries 1997 budget.
- Tunisian-Egyptan joint security commission started meeting on Tuesday in Cairo.
- Flights between Tunisia and the main European cities fully booked at the occasion of the end of the year holidays.
